s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/validate-a-server.md): Connects to the server, initializes the MCP session, and retu

er.\n- [Run the doctor](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/run-the-doctor.md): Runs the full doctor workflow

rver healthy, and why not.\"\n- [Check OAuth requirement](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/check-oauth-req
uirement.md): Lightweight, no MCP connection: reports whether the server is configured to require an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-tools.md): Returns the server's tools as a collection page. Each item is the
MCP tool definition (`name`, `description`, `inputSchema`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitiv
es/list-prompts.md): Returns the server's prompts as a collection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
primitives/list-resources.md): Returns the server's resources as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/primitives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a single resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the M
CP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained
server-side, because duplicate detection spans the whole listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/p
rimitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one skill by URI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against th
e manifest, the fetched frontmatter against what the listing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial li
sting never mentioned. When a check fails the response carries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-server-skills-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, ch
ecking its byte length and digest against the skill's own manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rath
er than accepted from the caller, so a request cannot authorize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/export/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lists tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON sna
pshot: handy for diffing a server's surface over time in CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call
-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of
`executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls**: the server answered; only transport/
auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Rend
ers a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App wid
get headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and
mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it lo
gged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained
widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local
Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the
original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromi
um context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.
md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or AP

n-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a

nce/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments r
eturn 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after i
ts idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https

ect and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List
a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per c
ommitted edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs wer
e launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send

ady there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The ac

t accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server

r's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"accou

rence/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, sa
me id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account h
as creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account
.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (bes
